_comment: BiteWise's own table of US restaurant chains with 20 or more locations (the FDA menu-labeling threshold, 21 CFR 101.11). The restaurant assist matches nearby places and printed brands against THIS table on the device and sends only the canonical name of a matched chain; 'domains' are the chain's own registrable web domains that may serve as an official nutrition source. Edit here, then run scripts/sync_shared.py. Refresh yearly.
source: Curated 2026-10-23 for BiteWise. Chains and US unit counts from the public lists below; each domain was checked live on 2026-10-23 (HTTPS home page reachable with the chain's own name in its title, or a bot-protection page on a domain long known to be the chain's). Chains whose domain had lapsed, redirected to an unrelated site or could not be verified were left out, as were chains without a source showing 20+ US locations.
